title: Button
description: The action control: one primary per area, secondary for the rest, danger for destructive actions, ghost for quiet ones. Spinner shows work in progress inside the control that runs it.

title: Button group
description: Joins related buttons into one segmented control: shared borders, outer corners only (‹ Hôm nay ›, Lưu | ▾).

title: Chip
description: A pill-shaped toggle for filters and tags. Neutral when off; active uses the high-contrast surface, with colour only on its dot or icon (tone).

title: External link
description: A link to another site: opens a new tab on desktop and the external browser inside a mobile WebView, with an external-link icon.

title: Pills
description: A single-choice filter of 2–5 options on one track (segmented look). The left side of a SubpageToolbar.

title: Toggle
description: Buttons that stay pressed. Toggle for one (pin, mute, bold); ToggleGroup for a set of icon or short options, one or several at a time (list / grid view, text styles).

title: Calendar
description: A month grid to pick one day or a range (YYYY-MM-DD, weeks start on Monday). DatePicker shows it in a popover; place it inline for schedules and report filters.

title: Checkbox
description: A native checkbox with label and description, checked fill in the accent, and an indeterminate state for “select all”.

title: Combobox
description: CustomCombobox: type to filter a long list, then pick one value.

title: Date picker
description: A date field with a Calendar popover (YYYY-MM-DD, min / max). Never type="date".

title: Field, Input, Textarea
description: Field gives any control a label, a hint and an error, wired for screen readers. Input and Textarea are the standard text controls (bg-field, h-field).

title: Input group
description: An input with fixed parts around it: a prefix (https://), a unit (kg, ₫), an icon or a small button (copy, show password).

title: Input OTP
description: One-time code entry (OTP, PIN, 2FA): boxes on screen, one real input underneath, so paste, SMS autofill, screen readers and the number keypad work like a normal field.

title: Number input
description: NumberInput: numbers with a touch keypad (NumPadPopup) on phones and tablets, plain typing elsewhere. Never type="number".

title: Radio group
description: Exactly one option of a few, each with an optional description; vertical by default.

title: Search input
description: The toolbar search: an icon button that opens into a field (clear button, h-control); it collapses again when empty and focus leaves. SubpageToolbar includes one.

title: Select
description: CustomSelect: pick one value from a list, in a field, in a toolbar, inline in a row or bare. Never the native <select>.

title: Slider
description: Pick a number in a range by dragging: one thumb, or two with range for a min–max pair.

title: Switch
description: An on / off toggle for settings that apply immediately.

title: Command
description: A command palette: type to filter actions and pages, ↑/↓ to move, Enter to run. Command is the inline list; CommandDialog opens it over the page, usually on ⌘K (useHotkey). Matching ignores case and Vietnamese marks.

title: Confirm dialog
description: confirmDialog() asks one yes / no question and resolves to true or false. Mount ConfirmHost once in the root layout. Never window.confirm.

title: Context menu
description: The menu of an area opened at the pointer: right-click, long-press on touch, or the Menu key / Shift+F10 when the area has focus.

title: Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from the right, left, bottom or top (a sheet), with title and footer.

title: Hover card
description: A preview card while the pointer rests on, or focus is on, a link: a person, a product, an order.

title: Menu
description: The overflow menu of a row or card: a ⋯ trigger (or your own) with items, icons, separators and a danger item last.

title: Modal
description: The shared dialog: full screen on phones, a centred panel from sm up, with title, description, body and footer. Focus is trapped and returns to the opener.

title: Popover
description: A small non-modal panel under its trigger for interactive content: a quick form, filters, a picker.

title: Toast
description: toast() shows a short message after an action, with a tone and an optional action (Hoàn tác). Mount ToastHost once in the root layout.

title: Tooltip
description: A short label on hover or focus, mostly for icon-only buttons.

title: App header
description: The top bar of a stand-alone tool app: logo + title go home, the module name, and one primary action on the right. No Home button.

title: App shell
description: The frame of a multi-page app: a floating bento sidebar (w-52, collapses to a w-14 icon rail) on bg-canvas, the content panel beside it, and MobileTabBar at the bottom on phones. This docs site is an AppShell.

title: Breadcrumb
description: Where the page sits: a trail of links ending with the current page. Long trails collapse their middle into a “…” menu.

title: Menubar
description: The menu bar of a desktop-style tool (Tệp · Sửa · Xem): menus that open from a bar and behave like Menu.

title: Navigation menu
description: Top navigation of a website or landing page: links, and items that open a panel of links with descriptions. Below md it becomes one menu button with a sheet.

title: Page actions
description: Lets a page put its actions into a slot of the shared header: PageActionsProvider wraps the layout, PageActionsSlot marks where they render, PageActions sends them from the page.

title: Page title
description: PageTitle is the large display title of a page (text only). PageTabsTitle turns it into 2–4 underline tabs for sibling pages.

title: Pagination
description: Page numbers with previous / next for long tables. For card lists prefer auto-loading with “Xem thêm”.

title: Resizable panels
description: Panels side by side or stacked with handles to resize them (an editor beside a preview, a list beside details). Sizes are percentages and can be remembered.

title: Scroll area
description: A fixed-size scrolling region (a long list in a card, a log). Semi hides scrollbars, so it marks the edges that have more content, can show a thin scrollbar, and is reachable by keyboard.

title: Side panel
description: A 320px tool panel beside a canvas that collapses to a 48px rail; SidePanelToggle is its collapse button.

title: Subpage toolbar
description: The sticky row under a page title: filters on the left; search, refresh and the icon-only primary action on the right. RefreshButton spins while its promise runs.

title: Tabs
description: Switch between panels of content inside a page or card: underline (default) or segmented, with icons and counts.

title: Accordion
description: A list of sections where one (or several) open at a time: FAQs, settings groups, help.

title: Aspect ratio
description: Keeps media at a fixed ratio while its width follows the layout (images, video, maps, 3D previews).

title: Avatar
description: A person or team: their image, or initials on a tone picked from the name.

title: Badge
description: A read-only status or tag in a tone (10% fill, 20% border, theme-safe text), with an optional dot or icon.

title: Card
description: The bento content card: panel fill and the style's card border, radius and resting shadow. interactive adds hover / press, active marks the selected or running item.

title: Carousel
description: Slides in a row that scroll by swipe, trackpad, arrow keys, buttons or dots (CSS scroll-snap, no library). Phones show one slide and a peek of the next.

title: Chart
description: Charts in SVG on Semi tokens, no library: BarChart (grouped or stacked columns), LineChart (optional area wash), DonutChart (parts of a whole) and Sparkline (a trend in a tile). Series use the fixed chart-1…8 colours (validated for colour-blind readers in both themes); every chart has a legend for 2+ series, a hover / keyboard tooltip and a table view.

title: Code block
description: Code to read or copy: a mono block with a copy button and an optional title (file name); long lines scroll sideways. Plain text, no highlighting.

title: Collapsible
description: One section that opens and closes under its trigger row (advanced options, details of a log line).

title: Data table
description: A table that sorts, filters, selects and pages rows on the client, built on Table: give it rows and columns, it keeps the state (or you control it).

title: Icon
description: The semantic icon registry (stroke 1.75, 24px grid). IconTile is the rounded tinted square that leads cards and dialogs.

title: Item
description: A list row — leading icon / avatar / image, title and description, meta on the right, actions — and ItemGroup, which stacks rows in a card with dividers.

title: Kbd
description: A key or a shortcut (⌘ K, Ctrl Enter) as key caps, for menus, tooltips, the command palette and help text.

title: KPI card
description: A metric card: label, a large tabular figure, a sub line coloured good / danger, and an icon in its tone.

title: Markdown
description: Renders AI or user text safely: paragraphs, lists, bold, inline code and links (as ExternalLink). No HTML.

title: Separator
description: A thin divider between groups of content: horizontal, vertical, or with a short label in the middle (“hoặc”).

title: Table
description: A dense table for rows compared column by column. Cells stay on one line (the table scrolls sideways on phones); TD wrap for a long-text column, numeric for figures.

title: Typography
description: The type scale (text-caption 11 … text-display 26, font-display for titles) and Prose, which styles long-form text — headings, paragraphs, lists, links, quotes, inline code — from that scale.

title: Alert
description: A message that stays on the page: info, success, warning, danger, with a title, an action and an optional dismiss.

title: Empty state
description: What an empty list or page shows: an icon, one short title, a description and the action that fills it.

title: Progress
description: A determinate bar with value, or an indeterminate one when the end is unknown; tones for success and danger.

title: Skeleton
description: Shimmer placeholders while content loads: Skeleton blocks, SkeletonCard, SkeletonGrid, SkeletonRows, PageSkeleton; Loading announces the region. Never “Đang tải…” text.

title: Action confirmation
description: An action the agent wants to take that needs a person's OK (send, delete, pay, run a command): what it will do, then Cho phép / Từ chối; the outcome replaces the buttons once decided.

title: AI chat
description: AIChat is the ready-made assistant panel: ChatPanel (side panel or full screen, resizable, keyboard inset) around ChatView (list + composer). UI only: the app keeps the messages, streams the answer and calls the model.

title: Chat messages
description: The parts of a conversation, to compose your own chat: UserMessage, AssistantMessage (+ ChatAnswer for a ChatItem), ChatThinking, ChatError, ChatCopyButton, ChatAvatar, ChatIntro, ChatSuggestion(s), ChatList and ChatComposer.

title: Chat model picker
description: Provider → model → effort chips, for the toolbar of a chat composer. The lists are app data.

title: Context meter
description: How full the model's context window is: a small ring with the percent, token counts in a tooltip; amber from 80%, red from 95%.

title: File tree
description: Files and folders as a keyboard tree, with A / M / D marks for what an agent added, modified or deleted; select a file to open it.

title: Reasoning
description: The model's reasoning above its answer: open while it streams, folded to “Đã suy luận trong N giây” when done, reopenable.

title: Sources
description: Where an answer came from: Citation marks inside the text (numbered, linked) and a Sources list under the answer that opens to the pages.

title: Task list
description: The agent's plan: steps with a status mark (chưa làm, đang làm, xong, lỗi, bỏ qua), an optional line under each, and a progress count.

title: Terminal
description: A command and its output: streams and follows the end (unless people scroll up), shows a spinner while running and the exit code when done, with a copy button.

title: Tool call
description: One tool the agent called: its name in words, a status badge (chờ, đang chạy, xong, lỗi, chờ duyệt), and on open the input and output (JSON formatted).

title: Agent workspace
description: A full agent turn composed from the AI parts: the request, reasoning, a plan, tool calls, an approval, the answer with sources and a composer with the context meter. Copy it with `semi add agent-run`.

title: Dashboard
description: An overview page: title, KPI row with trends, a revenue chart, orders by status and the latest orders. Copy it with `semi add dashboard`, then replace the sample data.

title: List page
description: A records page: title, toolbar (status pills, search, refresh, add), a data table that sorts, selects and pages, bulk actions. Copy it with `semi add list-page`.

title: Settings page
description: A settings page: sections of rows with switches and links, a profile form with validation and one save action, and a danger zone. Copy it with `semi add settings-page`.

title: Locale
description: SemiLocaleProvider sets the UI strings of every Semi component (Vietnamese by default, English shipped, override any string).

title: Theme
description: Light / dark / system: ThemeScript applies the stored theme before paint, ThemeProvider keeps it, ThemeSwitcher (three-way) and ThemeToggle switch it. data-theme on any element re-scopes every token inside it.
